newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-PaineWebbert cuts Union Texas EPS.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-PaineWebbert cuts Union Texas EPS.

text.p: --- PaineWebber is cutting its 1997 earnings per share estimates for Union Texas Petroleum Holdings Inc to $1.45 from $1.46, compared with analyst consensus forecasts of $1.58 because of a decrease in the brokerage's crude oil price forecast to $20.45 per barrel in 1997 from $21.50 and $20.00 for 1998 from $22.00.
-- PaineWebber is maintaining its "attractive" rating on the stock because its is trading at a discount to net asset value.

-- Analysts Ron Barone and Maria Gavalas have a 12 month price target of $24 per share, 6.3 times 1998 cashflow per share, compared 21-1/4 at which Union Texas Petroleum closed on Monday. ((-- New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
